# OffboardSet

> OffboardSet is employee offboarding software that turns every departure into a structured handoff: capture knowledge, revoke access, run exit interviews and stay connected with alumni before the last day.

## Product

- [Home](https://offboardset.com/): Features, how it works, pricing and FAQ
- [Pricing](https://offboardset.com/#pricing): Plans from $10/month, with a 14-day free trial on Starter and Growth
